headline: Dernier's bases-loaded sac fly walks off Pirates
recap: Ricky Jordan opened the bottom of the ninth with a double, moved to third on Tom Barrett's sacrifice bunt, and scored the winning run when Bob Dernier lifted a two-out sacrifice fly to center field, giving the Phillies a 3-2 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates. Pittsburgh reliever Bob Patterson intentionally walked Lenny Dykstra and Dickie Thon in between to load the bases, but Dernier's fly ball to center was deep enough to score Jordan anyway.

Pat Combs started for Philadelphia and worked six innings, allowing an unearned run on three hits while striking out four and walking three. Pittsburgh starter Neal Heaton went five innings and allowed two runs on five hits, including Dickie Thon's solo home run, his 11th of the season, in the fifth.

Jeff Parrett worked three innings of relief and was charged with the run that tied it in the eighth, an RBI sacrifice fly by Jay Bell that scored Barry Bonds, but he was on the mound when the Phillies won it in the ninth and picked up the win. Patterson, the fourth Pittsburgh pitcher of the day, took the loss.
